name: Oplany (Czechia)
description: Two vertical stripes of navy blue and white in the ratio 1:2 separated by a wavy line, with a yellow key with a cross-shaped bow in the blue and two green spruce trees with black trunks one above the other in the white.
history: Czech municipal flags are granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Parliament and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
